title: Longest Word In Dictionary
statement:
A word can be built one character at a time when every nonempty prefix of it is also in `words`. Return the longest buildable word; break equal-length ties by lexicographically smallest word. Return an empty string if none is buildable.

## Examples

```text
Input: words = ["w","wo","wor","worl","world"]
Output: "world"
```

```text
Input: words = ["a","banana","app","appl","ap","apply","apple"]
Output: "apple"
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= words.length <= 1000`
- `1 <= words[i].length <= 30`
- Words contain lowercase English letters
